verses.english: Numbered Discourses 3.124
13. At Kusinārā
Arguments

verses.pali: “Yassaṁ, bhikkhave, disāyaṁ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṁ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti, manasi kātumpi me esā, bhikkhave, disā na phāsu hoti, pageva gantuṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I’m not even comfortable thinking about a place where mendicants fight—quarreling and disputing, continually wounding each other with barbed words—let alone going there.
I come to a conclusion about them:

verses.pali: ‘addhā te āyasmanto tayo dhamme pajahiṁsu, tayo dhamme bahulamakaṁsu.
verses.english: ‘Clearly those venerables have given up three things and cultivated three things.’
What three things have they given up?
Thoughts of renunciation, good will, and harmlessness.
What three things have they cultivated?
Sensual, malicious, and cruel thoughts. …

verses.pali: Yassaṁ, bhikkhave, disāyaṁ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṁ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti, manasi kātumpi me esā, bhikkhave, disā na phāsu hoti, pageva gantuṁ.

verses.english: I come to a conclusion about them:

verses.pali: ‘addhā te āyasmanto ime tayo dhamme pajahiṁsu, ime tayo dhamme bahulamakaṁsu’.
verses.english: ‘Clearly those venerables have given up three things and cultivated three things.’

verses.pali: Yassaṁ pana, bhikkhave, disāyaṁ bhikkhū samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṁ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti, gantumpi me esā, bhikkhave, disā phāsu hoti, pageva manasi kātuṁ.
verses.english: I feel comfortable going to a place where the mendicants live in harmony—appreciating each other, without quarreling, blending like milk and water, and regarding each other with kindly eyes—let alone thinking about it.
I come to a conclusion about them:

verses.pali: ‘addhā te āyasmanto tayo dhamme pajahiṁsu, tayo dhamme bahulamakaṁsu.
verses.english: ‘Clearly those venerables have given up three things and cultivated three things.’
What three things have they given up?
Sensual, malicious, and cruel thoughts.
What three things have they cultivated?
Thoughts of renunciation, good will, and harmlessness. …

verses.pali: Yassaṁ, bhikkhave, disāyaṁ bhikkhū samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṁ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti, gantumpi me esā, bhikkhave, disā phāsu hoti, pageva manasi kātuṁ.

verses.english: I come to a conclusion about them:

verses.pali: ‘addhā te āyasmanto ime tayo dhamme pajahiṁsu, ime tayo dhamme bahulamakaṁsū’”ti.
verses.english: ‘Clearly those venerables have given up three things and cultivated three things.’”
